record.segment: Public doctoral university, 10,000–19,999 enrollment band, Southeast (Arkansas)
facts_carried_over: Tracy Finch is listed as Registrar; the Registrar’s Office owns enrollment, grading, academic records, scheduling, course evaluations, veterans benefits, and FERPA compliance. Source: Arkansas State University Registrar page, crawled 2026-09-02.

Faculty determine non-attendance and assign WN during the first 11 class days in fall/spring and first 5 in summer; for online courses, Canvas login is the eligibility test. Source: Arkansas State University Register/Add/Drop and grading guidance, crawled 2026-09-02.
A-State uses Banner Self Service for registration and grading records and Canvas as its LMS. Source: Arkansas State University registration and grading guidance, crawled 2026-09-02.

A-State’s Fall 2026 census date is September 2, 2026, and census data support official reporting, financial aid, and accreditation. Source: Arkansas State University Institutional Data and Analytics page, crawled 2026-08-30.
Fall 2025 enrollment was 17,926. Source: Arkansas State University news release, 2025-09-05.

Prior-term Canvas course access requires Tracy Finch’s approval before Information Technology Services acts. Source: Arkansas State University Canvas Live Course Access procedure, published 2026-03-02.
